chat.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

_why: Second hard question, different reasoning shape: MECHANISM synthesis across ch2+ch3
(the doc-2026-07-16 contradiction-finding style adapted to what the book contains).
ANSWER KEY (full prose in the plan doc §7):
1. The Nine loops one ~hour stretch — starts at seven past (Ode's stopped watch),
resets at the top of the hour — ch3 scene 2.
2. The reset pulls matter AND memory back: anyone who can't feel the deep Facets
'forgets the whole turn and lives it fresh' — ch3 scene 1.
3. So the three parties (Sedge's ledger, ch2 scene 1) never left: 'they're not
dead... still walking in. Every hour. For nine years' (ch3 sc 1); the third
party is in the east gallery believing it's the day they arrived (ch3 sc 2).
4. Ode remembers because deep-Facet sensitives stand 'slightly outside the loom'
and are NOT reset (ch3 sc 1) — the same exemption as Cael and Nettle.
A strong answer gives the loop mechanism + the forget rule + Ode's exemption; a
weak one says 'they were trapped' without the memory-reset mechanism.
